# Vikings Radio Finder

> Find the closest Minnesota Vikings radio station to your location using GPS

## Overview

Vikings Radio Finder (VikingsFinder) is a free web tool that helps Minnesota Vikings fans find the closest AM and FM radio stations broadcasting Vikings games near their current location. The app uses GPS/geolocation to calculate distances to actual FCC radio tower locations and ranks stations by estimated signal strength or distance.

For the 2026 season, about 70 Vikings Radio Network stations broadcast on 74 AM/FM frequencies across Minnesota (49), North Dakota (10), South Dakota (7), Iowa (5), and Wisconsin (3).

## Key Features

- GPS-based finder for the closest Vikings radio station to you right now
- Interactive map showing station locations and user position
- Sort by distance or by what should sound best at your location (estimated signal strength, with FM favored over AM at similar strength for its clearer audio)
- Pick any spot on the map (right-click, long-press, or the pin button) to rank stations for a place you're heading to instead of where you are
- Network coverage map: shade the whole region by estimated reception (Excellent / Good / Fair) from any station, reflecting AM day/night power
- No account required, completely free, privacy-focused (location stays on device)

## Major Vikings Radio Stations (2026)

- KFAN 100.3 FM - Minneapolis-St. Paul, MN (flagship; licensed as KFXN-FM)
- KTLK 1130 AM - Minneapolis-St. Paul, MN
- WEBC 560 AM - Duluth, MN
- KFYR 550 AM - Bismarck, ND
- WNAX 570 AM - Yankton, SD
- WMT 600 AM - Cedar Rapids, IA
- KXNO 1460 AM - Des Moines, IA
- WMEQ 880 AM - Eau Claire, WI

## Listening Outside the Network

The official Vikings app and NFL+ stream live game audio; SiriusXM carries every NFL game on a channel that changes weekly.

## Data Sources

- Station list: https://www.vikings.com/audio/radio-network
- Tower coordinates, power, and antenna height: FCC license records
